notes.title: v1.1 Sneak Peek and Release Date
notes.notes:
Back again with another sneak peek of v1.1, this time with a new feature: Tank Headlights and Taillights.  Customize your tank with different colors and combinations.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8045780/4276dea34ded31344ae5ee8bcb952b8863677457.jpg

This feature and many more will be in the v1.1 Update which drops...: Friday, March 31, 2023.
That's in 3 days!!  Are you ready?

--

--I have received reports recently about members of the community claiming to have a development position or inside knowledge of SSL development.  I want to make it clear that this is still a one-man operation and community members who claim to have inside knowledge aren't being truthful.  I am not currently active on Discord and any official news will be posted here on Steam!  I also want to clarify that using any software to aim-assist or xp-farm is against the SSL Terms of Service and can result in an account ban.  We're going to be more strict about this moving forward.

With that said... I'm just tying up some loose ends and doing some last minute testing on the update.  There also miiiiiight be a return of a certain minigame beloved by the SSL2 Flash community... but that's just a rumor.  See you Friday!

notes.title: Mobile Release & v1.1
notes.notes:
Mobile Release!

ShellShock Live has officially been released for Android and iOS!  Search 'ShellShock Live' on the your respective app store to find it.  It's $4.99, and you will not need to re-purchase it if you purchased the beta.  Crossplay is supported between iOS and Android, but not between mobile and other platforms as they are different games on different development tracks.

v1.1 Dev Update

Now that the mobile game has launched, we'll need to make sure it's running smoothly before moving on to v1.1 development.  We also need to add v1.0 features to the mobile version (we split off development from the Steam version before Steam v1.0 was created, so we have some work to add those features to the mobile game).  Once, that's done it's full steam ahead on v1.1 for all platforms!

Thanks for being along for the ride.

-kChamp

notes.title: ShellShock Live Mobile Beta & v1.1 Dev Update
notes.notes:
Mobile Beta

*EDIT* Thank you to all who participated in the mobile beta (4/7 - 4/15)!  We were able to squash some bugs and add some useful features and tweaks.  More importantly, it was a great test run for the upcoming mobile launch on May 12th!  The game won't be playable until then, but feel free to Pre-Register on Android or Pre-Order on iOS by searching 'ShellShock Live' on the respective app store.

v1.1 Dev Update

Thanks for your suggestions in the last post!  Most of our effort is going towards getting the mobile app running smoothly, but once that's done all our dev firepower will be pointed towards v1.1.  Here's a sneak peek at what we have in the works right now:

Daily Challenges for gears, xp, and rewards
More in-depth cosmetic customizations
Plenty of new weapons
Bug fixes and balance tweaks

There are a few more planned items I want to list here but won't yet because I'm not 100% sure they'll make it.  Stay tuned for a more detailed feature list as we get further with v1.1 development.

Thanks for reading and I'll see you on the battlefield!

-kChamp

notes.title: Dev Update | Mobile Version | v1.1
notes.notes:
It's been a while since I last posted so I wanted to bring you up to speed on the current development roadmap for ShellShock Live.  We've got some big things in the works.

Mobile Version
It's official- we're coming to iOS and Android!  I can't count how many requests I've gotten to bring SSL to mobile platforms, so we've been hard at work for the past several months to make it happen.  There are a few simplifications and UI changes, but for the most part mobile players will be getting the full game experience!  Crossplay will be supported between iOS and Android, but not between mobile and PC based on some backend limitations.  We're probably looking at a price of $4.99, but this could all change as we get closer to release.  We'll likely be running a beta prior to release, so if you'd like to be a part of that, sign up via the Google Form here: Beta Sign-Up

v1.1
Once the mobile version is released, we'll be turning our attention towards v1.1.  We have a few ideas, but now is your chance to submit yours!  What feature requests (or big fixes) would you like to see in the new version?

notes.title: v0.9.8.10 Mini-Update Released!
notes.notes:
Some players have been complaining of connection issues with ShellShock Live for a long time.  Today's mini-update adds a new system that intelligently tries to reconnect users disconnected by an 'EndRead' or 'ReceivedBytes == 0' error.  If reconnected successfully, you should never notice you were disconnected in the first place.  Previously, you would have been kicked out of the game (and match) and forced to reconnect from scratch.  This feature is early in development, so it might not always work, but it's a start.

For those of you affected by connection issues, please let me know if this update helps improve the situation.

Thanks!

-Kyle
